backlog.title: Coordinate Workspace & Sprint Planning
backlog.story: To collaborate effectively and deliver the project, the team will set up a shared project workspace and sprint plan. Set up the project environment, assign responsibilities, define communication channels, and prepare Scrum artefacts before development begins.
acceptance_criteria: The Trello board has a Product Backlog list and one list per sprint week, and every member can open it.
Each member's role and responsibilities are written down in the team charter.
The team has agreed on communication channels and meeting times, and recorded them.
tasks: Create the Trello board with Product Backlog and Sprint Week lists
Invite all four team members and assign roles
Agree on communication channels and the stand-up schedule
Set up the shared GitHub repository and document storage
Write a Definition of Done for the team

backlog.title: Define Business Concept
backlog.story: As an international student, I want one trusted platform that provides all the services I need for studying in South Africa so that I don't have to search multiple websites.
acceptance_criteria: The problem statement, the solution and the target beneficiaries are documented.
The core services are listed: SAQA evaluation, visa guidance, university applications and accommodation.
The value proposition and trust factors have been presented to the supervisor and the feedback recorded.
tasks: Write the problem statement and identify the target beneficiaries
Define the list of NavigSA services
Draft the value proposition and trust factors, with references
Prepare and deliver the business concept presentation
Turn supervisor feedback into backlog changes

backlog.title: Conduct Community & Market Research
backlog.story: As an international student, I want NavigSA to understand my challenges so that the services offered solve my real problems.
acceptance_criteria: Interviews with international students and service providers have been completed and summarised.
The identified problems are ranked by how often they happen, how urgent they are and how important they are.
There is evidence of whether students would pay for a solution.
tasks: Draft the interview questions
Interview international students and relevant service providers
Analyse the findings and rank the problems
Build the customer profile (needs, where to reach them, when they need help)
Validate problem urgency and willingness to pay

backlog.title: Feasibility & Business Planning
backlog.story: As an international student, I want affordable service packages so that I can choose support that fits my budget.
acceptance_criteria: Service packages are defined, each with a price and what it includes.
Cost and revenue projections show whether the business is viable.
The feasibility study is complete and has a clear conclusion.
tasks: Research competitor and agent pricing
Define the service packages and prices
Build the cost and revenue projection
Write the feasibility study

backlog.title: Discover NavigSA Through Marketing
backlog.story: As a prospective international student, I want to discover NavigSA through trusted online platforms so that I can learn about the services available before starting my application.
acceptance_criteria: The brand guide (logo, colours, fonts, tone) is used on the website and on every marketing post.
NavigSA social media pages are live and linked from the website.
Enquiries from marketing channels are recorded so that we can see which channels work.
tasks: Create and finalise the NavigSA brand guide
Set up the social media accounts
Plan a content calendar
Share content in international student communities
Track enquiries by source

backlog.title: Build Strategic Partnerships
backlog.story: As an international student, I want NavigSA to partner with trusted organisations so that I can access reliable services from verified providers.
acceptance_criteria: A shortlist of target partners (institutions, accommodation providers, agents) is documented.
The outreach status of each partner is recorded.
Partners that have agreed appear on the website, with their permission.
tasks: Identify the target partner organisations
Write a partnership proposal
Contact partners and log their responses
Add the confirmed partners to the website

backlog.title: Present Project Progress
backlog.story: To get feedback and show that the project is meeting its objectives, the team will present its progress to the project supervisor at each milestone.
acceptance_criteria: Each milestone presentation is delivered on its scheduled date.
Each presentation shows working results (a prototype, the backend or the live site), not only slides.
The supervisor's feedback is added to the backlog as new or updated cards.
tasks: Prepare the slides and the demo
Rehearse as a team
Deliver the presentation
Log the feedback on Trello

backlog.title: Complete Final Academic Documentation
backlog.story: To meet all WIL requirements, the team will compile and submit complete, well-structured project documentation.
acceptance_criteria: All monthly project reports have been submitted on time.
The sprint documentation and the agile logbook are complete and up to date.
The Trello board shows the true final status of every card.
tasks: Complete the monthly project reports
Keep the sprint boards and logbook up to date
Compile the WIL documentation
Submit the documentation and check that it was received

backlog.title: Platform Design (UI/UX)
backlog.story: As an international student, I want an attractive and easy-to-use website so that I can quickly understand NavigSA's services.
acceptance_criteria: Wireframes exist for the home, services, registration, dashboard and provider onboarding pages.
The clickable prototype uses the brand guide and works on mobile and desktop.
The prototype has been reviewed by the team and the supervisor, and the changes recorded.
tasks: Draw the sitemap and the main user flows
Design the student registration and verification screens
Design the service provider onboarding screens
Design the multilingual content interface
Define the website and technical structure
Present the prototype for review

backlog.title: Create Student Account
backlog.story: As an international student, I want to create a NavigSA account so that I can access personalised services.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid details, when I submit the registration form, my account is created and a confirmation is shown.
If my email address is already registered, the form says so and does not create a second account.
Required fields are checked before submission, and the password is stored only as a hash.
tasks: Build the registration form
Add client-side and server-side validation
Create the registration API endpoint
Hash passwords and save the student record
Test valid, duplicate and invalid sign-ups

backlog.title: Secure Login
backlog.story: As an international student, I want to log into my account securely so that I can access my personal dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given correct credentials, when I log in, I am taken to my dashboard.
Given wrong credentials, I see a general error that does not say which field was wrong.
Repeated failed attempts are slowed down or blocked, and logging out ends my session.
tasks: Build the login form
Create the authentication endpoint and session or token handling
Add a limit on failed login attempts
Add logout
Test successful, failed and locked-out logins

backlog.title: Manage Student Profile
backlog.story: As an international student, I want to update my personal profile so that my information stays accurate throughout my application journey.
acceptance_criteria: I can view my profile details.
I can edit and save my details, and invalid values are rejected with a clear message.
The saved changes show on my dashboard straight away.
tasks: Build the profile page
Create the profile update endpoint
Add validation
Test viewing and editing the profile

backlog.title: Browse Available Services
backlog.story: As an international student, I want to browse all available NavigSA services so that I can decide which service best suits my needs.
acceptance_criteria: The services page lists every service with a short description and its price.
Each service has a detail view and a button to book it.
The page is easy to use on a mobile phone.
tasks: Define the service data (name, description, price, category)
Build the services listing page
Build the service detail view
Link each service to booking
Test the layout on mobile and desktop

backlog.title: Upload Verification Documents
backlog.story: As an international student, I want to upload my academic and identity documents securely so that my application can be verified.
acceptance_criteria: I can upload PDF, JPG or PNG files up to the set size limit. Other files are rejected with a clear message.
Only I and the administrator can open my documents.
After uploading, each document shows the status "Pending review".
tasks: Build the upload screen
Validate file type and size
Store files in private storage
Restrict access to the owner and the administrator
Show the document status on the dashboard
Test valid and invalid uploads and the access rules

backlog.title: View Student Dashboard
backlog.story: As an international student, I want to view my dashboard so that I can access all my information and services from one place.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard shows my profile summary, application status, bookings, notifications and uploaded documents.
The data comes from the backend and is up to date when the page loads.
Only I can see my dashboard. Anyone who is not logged in is sent to the login page.
tasks: Build the dashboard layout
Add the bookings, appointments and notifications panels
Connect the dashboard to the backend APIs
Protect the route so that only logged-in users can open it
Test with real account data

backlog.title: Track Application Status
backlog.story: As an international student, I want to track my application progress so that I always know what stage my application is in.
acceptance_criteria: Each application shows one of these statuses: Submitted, Under review, Action required or Approved.
When the administrator changes a status, my dashboard shows the change and I am notified.
I can see the history of status changes with dates.
tasks: Define the status values and the data model
Let the administrator update a status
Show a status timeline to the student
Send a notification when the status changes
Test every status change

backlog.title: Book a NavigSA Service
backlog.story: As an international student, I want to book a NavigSA service so that I can receive assistance with my study journey.
acceptance_criteria: I can choose a service and a date and time, then submit a booking.
Dates in the past cannot be selected.
I receive a confirmation, and the booking appears on my dashboard.
tasks: Build the booking form
Create the booking API and validation
Send a booking confirmation
Show bookings on the dashboard
Test valid and invalid bookings

backlog.title: Receive Notifications and Reminders
backlog.story: As an international student, I want to receive reminders and notifications so that I never miss important application deadlines or updates.
acceptance_criteria: I am notified when my application status changes or when a booking is confirmed.
I receive a reminder before an upcoming deadline or appointment.
I can mark notifications as read.
tasks: Create the notification data model
Add the triggers for status changes, bookings and deadlines
Build the in-app notification list
Add email delivery
Test each trigger

backlog.title: Register as a Service Provider
backlog.story: As a service provider, I want to register on NavigSA so that I can offer my services to international students.
acceptance_criteria: I can register with my business details and upload my accreditation documents.
After registering, my account status is "Pending verification".
My services are not shown to students until I am verified.
tasks: Build the provider onboarding form
Add the accreditation document upload
Create the provider registration API
Hide unverified providers from the public pages
Test the registration flow

backlog.title: Become a Verified Service Provider
backlog.story: As a service provider, I want to become verified so that students trust the services I provide.
acceptance_criteria: The verification criteria are documented.
The administrator can approve or reject a provider and must give a reason for a rejection.
Approved providers show a "Verified" badge, and every provider is notified of the decision.
tasks: Define the verification requirements
Build the administrator review screen
Add the "Verified" badge to provider listings
Notify providers of the outcome
Test approval and rejection

backlog.title: Administrator Manages Users
backlog.story: As an administrator, I want to manage students and service providers so that I can maintain a secure and trusted platform.
acceptance_criteria: The administrator can search and view all students and providers.
The administrator can suspend and reactivate an account.
Only users with the admin role can open these pages, and every admin action is logged.
tasks: Add the admin role and its access control
Build the user list with search
Add suspend and reactivate actions
Record admin actions in an audit log
Test that non-admin users cannot access the pages

backlog.title: Submit Reviews
backlog.story: As an international student, I want to leave a review after receiving a service so that I can share my experience with other students.
acceptance_criteria: Only a student with a completed booking can review that service.
A review has a rating from 1 to 5 and a comment, and there is one review per booking.
Reviews follow the agreed review rules and can be removed by the administrator if they are abusive.
tasks: Define the review and refund rules
Build the review form
Check review eligibility in the API
Add admin moderation
Show reviews on the service pages

backlog.title: View Testimonials
backlog.story: As an international student, I want to read testimonials from previous users so that I can make informed decisions before using NavigSA.
acceptance_criteria: The home page shows testimonials from verified users only.
The administrator approves each testimonial before it is published.
A testimonial shows the user's name and country only if they have given consent.
tasks: Build the testimonials section
Add the admin approval step
Record user consent
Test publishing and hiding testimonials

backlog.title: Access Multilingual Content
backlog.story: As a French- or Portuguese-speaking international student, I want to read information in my preferred language so that I clearly understand every step of the application process.
acceptance_criteria: A language switcher offers English, French and Portuguese, and remembers my choice.
All main pages and messages are translated.
A fluent speaker has reviewed the translations for accuracy.
tasks: Design the language switcher
Set up translation files
Translate the page content into French and Portuguese
Have a fluent speaker review the translations
Test every page in each language

backlog.title: Learn Through Educational Content
backlog.story: As an international student, I want access to educational guides and videos so that I understand the SAQA, visa, university application, and accommodation processes before I begin my journey.
acceptance_criteria: There are guides for SAQA evaluation, study visas, university applications and accommodation.
Each guide is available in English, French and Portuguese.
Each guide lists its official sources and the date it was last reviewed.
tasks: Research the official processes and sources
Write the guides
Produce the short explainer videos
Translate the guides
Publish the guides on the platform

backlog.title: Protect Student Information (Operations & Compliance)
backlog.story: As an international student, I want my personal information and documents to be stored securely so that my privacy is protected and I can trust NavigSA.
acceptance_criteria: A privacy policy that follows the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) is published on the site.
The site uses HTTPS, passwords are hashed and documents can only be opened by authorised users.
The procedures for handling data and responding to security incidents are documented.
tasks: Design the platform's security structure
Design and implement the database and models
Prepare secure backend APIs
Review the POPIA, privacy and compliance requirements
Review the technical security measures
Document the operational and security procedures

backlog.title: Use a Reliable Platform (Testing & Quality Assurance)
backlog.story: As an international student, I want the NavigSA platform to work reliably so that I can complete my applications without errors or interruptions.
acceptance_criteria: Test cases based on the acceptance criteria of every Must story have been run.
Every defect is logged, and all critical defects are fixed before launch.
User acceptance testing has been done with sample users and their feedback recorded.
tasks: Write the test plan and test cases
Test the main student features
Test the frontend and backend working together
Run user acceptance testing with sample users
Fix the defects found
Run a final test on the live site

backlog.title: Access the Live NavigSA Platform (Deployment & Launch)
backlog.story: As an international student, I want the NavigSA platform to be available online so that I can access its services from anywhere.
acceptance_criteria: The website and the backend are live on a public HTTPS address.
A smoke test of registration, login and the dashboard passes after every deployment.
The website link has been submitted as required.
tasks: Deploy the backend and fix any deployment issues
Deploy the frontend
Configure the domain and HTTPS
Run the smoke test
Submit the website link

backlog.title: Store My Information Securely (Backend & Database)
backlog.story: As an international student, I want my information to be stored securely so that I can safely use NavigSA's services. One story delivered through four tasks across Sprints 29-32 (Sprint Week 8): backend setup, database design, database models and backend APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Student and provider data is saved in the database and is still there after the server restarts.
Passwords are stored only as hashes, and every API call that reads or writes personal data requires a logged-in user.
The backend APIs return clear errors for invalid or missing data and have been tested.
tasks: Task 1 (Sprint 29): Set up the backend project
Task 2 (Sprint 30): Design the database
Task 3 (Sprint 31): Implement the database models
Task 4 (Sprint 32): Prepare the backend APIs
